treatment.logline: In a monsoon downpour on a Colombo roadside, a shy street-food vendor returns a dropped phone to a young woman; a spark flickers until a call from home breaks the moment, leaving a promise hanging in the rain.

arc.beat: The rain and Kasun’s drive set the world.
arc.feeling: Absorbing the city’s weight and his quiet ambition under the rain.

arc.beat: An elegant stranger arrives; chance sets a path.
arc.feeling: A sudden alignment—two paths about to cross.
Warmth and interest blooming between caution and pride.

arc.beat: Interruption: duty calls and the mood turns.
arc.feeling: A gentle lift collapses into a quiet ache.

arc.beat: Parting and a hint of destiny.
arc.feeling: Distance grows; fate whispers over the storm.

treatment.approach: Naturalistic handheld and restrained moves, letting rain, texture and faces carry the scene. Keep coverage simple: a few purposeful singles for key lines, one wide to hold geography and parting, and a soft push when ambition or separation needs weight. Keep the physical light consistent—monsoon diffuse daylight with constant heavy rain—while allowing a slightly warmer grade on faces in the brief connection, then cooler when the call intrudes.

colour_script.palette: Cool greys and wet asphalt blues with muted shopfront colours; warm browns in the tea.
colour_script.light: Soft, overcast monsoon daylight with steady rain and reflective puddles.
colour_script.grade: Naturalistic with a slight cool bias; subtle film-like contrast.

colour_script.palette: Cool rain with a pop of neutral elegance in Anudi’s blouse and handbag.
colour_script.light: Same soft rain light; umbrella adds gentle top shadow.
colour_script.grade: Neutral-cool base; skin tones kept natural.

colour_script.light: Consistent rain daylight; steam and stall reflectors add warmth.
colour_script.grade: Subtle warmth lift on faces; still rain-cooled overall.

colour_script.palette: Cooler shift; desaturation of background greens and blues.
colour_script.light: Unchanged physical light; emotional coolness through grading only.
colour_script.grade: Dial back warmth; slightly lower saturation.

colour_script.palette: Return a touch of warmth in skin tones against cool rain.
Cool-wet cityscape; Kasun grounded in gentle warmth.

treatment.geography: Kasun’s three-wheeler stall is curbside on a Colombo street: the tuk-tuk parked nose-out, a small counter under a narrow awning, handwritten menu clipped to the side, tea flask steaming, puddles and passing traffic in front. Across the road, a family car pulls up; Anudi steps out by the curb with an umbrella, then crosses toward the stall’s side.
treatment.key_image: Rain streaks across frame as Anudi looks back over her umbrella at Kasun; the city blurs behind them.
advice: Hold the rain texture: puddles, droplets on lens edge, steam from tea—these sell place.
Faces are the story. Give clean singles for L7, L11, L13, L19.
Keep the call unseen; play it on Anudi’s face and body only.
Use one decisive wide for geography and the parting; don’t over-cover.
Avoid reflections or readable phone screens; keep action physical and simple.
Protect handles: about 1s pre/post each action for cutting room.

sequences.title: Rain and resolve
sequences.purpose: Establish place, Kasun’s grind, and his inner drive.

sequences.title: The arrival
sequences.purpose: Anudi enters; the phone drop sets the meet.

sequences.title: The first exchange
sequences.purpose: Polite return turns into curiosity and pride.

moments.what: Heavy rain on the street; Kasun works the stall, his ambition clear as his inner thought plays over his face.
moments.feeling: Soaked determination with a private dream.
moments.cut_uses: Start on a locked-off wide master for geography, then a gentle push-in single on Kasun for the thought; simple angles that let rain and eyes play.

moments.what: Anudi steps out from a car with umbrella; her phone slips; Kasun grabs it and moves toward her.
moments.feeling: A fated slip; energy lifts as he decides.
moments.cut_uses: Locked-off wide on her step and drop, then a handheld follow on Kasun to inject urgency.

moments.what: He calls out and returns the phone; she turns, thanks him, then really sees his stall and asks about it; he smiles and, with pride, shares his start.
moments.feeling: Warmth and curiosity, a first glimmer of connection.
moments.cut_uses: Clean singles: his single for L7 and L13; her single (locked-off with a gentle rack to the stall) for her turn, gratitude and L11; a brief reaction on his smile to let her line land.

moments.what: Her returned smile is cut off by a ring; she answers, listens, and her expression falls.
moments.cut_uses: Hold her single, no cuts—let the ring and unseen voice work on her face.

moments.what: She looks back to him and offers a fragile promise.
moments.cut_uses: Her single to carry L19 cleanly.

moments.what: She walks away; he watches her go as narration frames the moment.
moments.feeling: Bittersweet distance with destiny closing in.
moments.cut_uses: A slow dolly-out wide that holds both of them as space opens; narration over the rain.

editor_notes: Target around 60s of takes; keep coverage lean and specific to the emotional turns.

Must angles: WIDE master (b0-b1), Kasun single with thought (b2-b3), arrival/drop wide (b4-b5), Kasun follow (b6), Kasun singles for L7 and L13, Anudi single for b8-b11 and for L19, Anudi single through the call (b14-b17), parting wide with VO (b20-b22).
Optional extra: one insert on the handwritten menu/short eats can help bridge b10-b11 if timing needs air.
VO/thought/call are never performed on camera; play them over picture. Keep Father unseen and unnamed in any picture text.
Rain continuity: keep the same physical light and rainfall density across shots; avoid strobing water patterns between setups.
No readable phone screens or reflections; keep actions physical and simple.
Post can adjust grade warmth/cool per sequence; consider a gentle punch-in on L13 if needed—shoot at 4K to allow it.
